card.statement: $\MM^\mathbb{A}(\lambda,\VV)$ is a weight module with the weight decomposition $\MM^\mathbb{A}(\lambda,\VV)=\bigoplus_{\mu \in P}\MM^\mathbb{A}(\lambda,\VV)_\mu$, where $\MM^\mathbb{A}(\lambda,\VV)_\mu=\MM^\mathbb{A}(\lambda,\VV)\cap \MM_q(\lambda,\VV)_\mu$.
card.label: Proposition 14

paper.title: Quantum affine modules for non-twisted Affine Kac-Moody algebras
paper.abstract: We construct new irreducible weight modules over quantum affine algebras of type I with all weight spaces infinite-dimensional. These modules are obtained by parabolic induction from irreducible modules over the Heisenberg subalgebra.
